title: A Sync from live puts in place only the tables that differ from its point; the others keep their rows and triggers, and a cut-off sync is still recovered
expect: S1: the cut keeps the named tables with their triggers between the dump's head and tail; after a sync the changed table was put in place, an unchanged one kept its create_time and trigger, a Before-restore point exists; every cut-off recovery case still settles

selectors.host: webroot-sync.sh apply only-tables.txt, webroot-backup.sh --only-tables --sealed only_load_start, lib/dump_tables.py

fence: A sync never swaps a table it did not change, and never without its way back
